name: MPTrj
brief: Frames pulled from Materials Project relaxation and static calculations — intermediate steps, not just relaxed endpoints, curated and deduplicated — with magnetic moments among the labels. A standard pretraining corpus for universal inorganic potentials: CHGNet was built on it, MACE-MP-0 trained on it directly, and the Orb models use it alongside Alexandria.
dftLevel: PBE (+U for some TM oxides); VASP
paperTitle: CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling
primaryPaper: Deng et al., CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling, Nat. Mach. Intell. 5:1031 (2023).
